review: The Farmhouse pizza is my go to, fresh veggies and a good amount of cheese.
Pizza tastes good but the prices have gone up a lot recently.
Weekday offers make it good value for a group of friends.
The app is easy to use and live tracking tells you exactly when the order will arrive.
Choco lava cake is still the best dessert on the menu.
The delivery guy was late by 20 minutes and the garlic bread was cold.
Delivery arrived in under 30 minutes and the pizza was still hot.
The base was soggy and there was hardly any cheese on our Margherita.
Customer care took three days to refund a missing item.
Consistent taste every time, you know exactly what you are getting.
Late night delivery is a lifesaver during exams, always reliable.
Staff at the counter were quick and polite even on a busy Saturday.
Toppings were thrown on one side of the pizza and the crust was burnt.
The dine in area is small and cramped, better to order home.
The sides are overpriced for the tiny portions you get.
Cheese burst crust is unbeatable, worth every rupee.
